drift_step: library default: half a boxcar of smear over the integration
grouping_rule: sort a day's candidates by frequency; chain neighbours whose ratio is at most GROUP_RATIO; any chain of three or more is a group to fit
integrations: every integration present in each file
purpose: expand frequency coverage from the survey's 96-channel window to all 731 channels of every available day, and from 1000 samples to every integration, before inspecting anything in the new coverage

verdict_rules.decisive: delta AIC > 10 and the same model wins held-out prediction
verdict_rules.noise: RMS residual above half a channel means neither model fits
verdict_rules.replication: SCALE FAMILY SUPPORTED additionally needs the same q on at least two separated groups or dates
verdict_rules.span: a group spanning under one phi rung cannot return SCALE FAMILY SUPPORTED or FREQUENCY COMB SUPPORTED; at most BOTH MODELS FIT or INDETERMINATE DUE TO LIMITED SPAN
